title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Process of a Small-Scale Coffee Roastery
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which a small-scale coffee roastery turns green coffee beans into packaged roasted beans ready for sale. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花约2分钟读图，确认流程的起点、终点以及各步骤的先后顺序；写作时用一般现在时被动语态描述过程，并用恰当的连接词（first, next, after that, finally）标明顺序。注意挑选2–4个重要特征进行概括和比较，不要逐步骤机械罗列，也不要加入个人观点或解释原因。建议写完后检查字数是否达到150词，并核对是否覆盖了流程的主要阶段。

figure.title: From Green Beans to Packaged Roasted Coffee: The Production Process at a Small Roastery
steps: Green coffee beans are delivered in 60 kg sacks and weighed on arrival.
Beans are cleaned by hand and any defective beans are removed.
Beans are stored in breathable cotton bags for 24 hours to stabilise moisture.
A sample of 500 g is roasted in a drum roaster at 210°C for 12 minutes.
Hot roasted beans are cooled in a rotating tray for 5 minutes.
Cooled beans rest in open containers for 8 hours to release carbon dioxide.
Beans are ground to order in a burr grinder and weighed into 250 g portions.
Portions are sealed in one-way valve bags, labelled with the roast date, and packed into boxes of 12 for dispatch.
